avis.titre: Great option for clean under-eye patches
avis.texte: I usually get reactions around my eyes if there are any harsh ingredients in products meant for the under-eye area. I've tried these four times, and so far, so good! I haven't had a single reaction to them. Overall, they are cooling on the under-eyes, especially if you keep them in the fridge. They seem to make my eyes look less tired and more hydrated the next morning! However, one downside is the packaging. I really wish they took inspiration from other brands and used jar packaging. I think it would be 1) less wasteful with all the packaging and 2) more effective, as I personally think eye patches in good, airtight jars contain more moisture. The current packaging allows some leakage from where the patches lay. Either way, I will still repurchase these often, considering how clean the ingredients are and the fact that I haven't used a different brand that didn't give me a reaction.

I tried this product and I loved it. However, my boyfriend had an a bad allergic reaction to it for some reason.
